prompt: Build one list of every price seen for product 2: each list price version in price_history and each competitor price check in competitor_prices. Return two columns, in this order: source, the text 'Voltmarkt' for a list price version or the competitor's name for a price check, and price_eur, the list price or the checked price. Return one row for each list price version and one for each price check, so a price that repeats appears every time it was set or seen. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per list price version or price check

hints: Next, stack the price checks under the list price versions, with the same two columns in the same order.
UNION ALL keeps every row of both parts. UNION would drop the repeats, so a price seen in many weeks would count once. The column names come from the first SELECT.
why_this_works: UNION ALL stacks the two lists as they are, so every list price version and every check stays, repeats included.
